svg.title: Evolution — motion studies and HUD concept board
svg.text: Concept board · dark-field microscopy · each strip is 6 keyframes of one player action; right column is the in-game HUD and the level-up trait picker at 1920×1080 / 0.37
small mote, ~300 ms, interruptible, plays on every mote
prey cell, 1.2 s process, predator −40 % speed, escape window until Seal
once per level, 0.9 s, not interruptible, opens the trait picker on frame 6
level ring + mass, leaderboard, trait strip, minimap, engulf warning, round timer
3 cards, keys 1-3, 10 s timer, hover preview, auto-pick
sim keeps running · hover previews the trait on your cell · auto-picks the highlighted card at 0 s
· Scale pulses never exceed 1.14× and always return through an overshoot ≤ 3 %.
· Membrane deformation is a radial bump (Gaussian, σ in degrees) on a 36-point loop, never a vertex jump.
· Every strip is driven by t; frames are the keyframes, tweens use the named easing on the bar.
· Glow = bright core + soft halo + white glint (ASSET-GENERATION §1.5); rim stroke = 5.5 % of radius, min 1.6 px.
· HUD never covers the ±120 px around the player cell; the picker dims the dish to 45 % but never pauses it.
